feature_notes: Completes the agreed M4 stage for supported ordinary loaded workbooks: one canonical lazy bank with joint resource reservations, repeatable preserving saves, stable live handles, worksheet creation/copy/removal/rename/reordering/visibility/active selection, append, physical-cell removal, row/column insertion/deletion and sparse range copy/move with normal-formula translation. Package declarations, relationships and content types are synchronized; detached aliases and deleted-title reuse remain independent. Affected unmodeled M5/M6 graphs, local defined-name owners and linked VBA identities reject structural mutations explicitly. Full M4 remains open for those tracked feature dependencies. Serial 200k/2m-cell complete-save/readback evidence records RSS and temporary storage. Calamine speed targets and conservative virtual memory accounting remain A8 work; no universal speed or dataframe integration claim.
